title: Densest Diverse Subgraphs: How to Plan a Successful Cocktail Party with Diversity

problem.claim: Dense subgraph discovery is used to identify teams of skilled individuals for collaboration in social networks.

gap.claim: When network nodes have sensitive attributes, existing approaches may produce insufficient diversity, creating legal risk.

narrative_sequence.summary: Dense subgraph discovery supports applications such as forming skilled collaboration teams from social networks.
Insufficient diversity in networks with sensitive attributes can lead to lawsuits.

unknowns: The proposed method or system is not described.
No theoretical results, experiments, datasets, baselines, or quantitative findings are provided.
The meaning of diversity and the treatment of sensitive attributes are unspecified.
